featured_reviews.name: Harshada Thakur
featured_reviews.review_text:
It’s my second time purchasing products from Make Over, and unfortunately both experiences were disappointing.

After their renovation, I noticed they were keeping expired products on the shelves — that was my first bad experience.

The second incident was with the Miss Claire Waterproof Mascara. Many people don’t just use mascara for lashes, but also to cover grey hair near the crown area, which is what I did. After applying it, my hair became extremely stiff and hard to comb, and it even caused hair breakage.

I would strongly recommend checking products carefully before buying. Avoid purchasing skin and hair products from here, as the quality seems questionable and the products may be duplicate.
